A.title: Foot of the Sky-Stair
A.text: The sky-stair lands here, broken at the bottom as well. They built it to climb, and then they ran out of reasons. The last step is polished by feet.

Y.title: The Hall Where They Agreed
Y.text: The two ages met in this hall, high-tech lords on one side and cultivators on the other. It took years. They called it the Accord.

R.title: Breath Under the Heart
R.text: The old stone says only this: the breath that lifts you is the breath that sets you down. Learn both and you do not fall.

G.title: Why Balance
G.text: Written plain on the wall: if one side wins, the other side is gone, and then the winner starves. The Accord was not mercy. It was arithmetic.

M.title: The Forgetting
M.text: After the Accord, the people agreed to forget. Not the war, the hate. The rest slipped out with it. That is why you do not know your own history.

O.title: Five and the Cycle
O.text: Five of them, always. Each feeds the next and holds another in check. Take one out and the cycle limps. Put it back and it walks.

U.title: What the Survivor Left Out
U.text: Scratched low, by a tired hand: I told Eliet the Deep killed eight. It did not. We came wanting the Heart, out of balance, and the Deep set us right. Eight stayed, and I walked back alone.

X.title: Note to Whoever Comes Next
X.text: The Heart does not want your death. It wants you level. Put down what you carried too long, pick up what you left behind, and go home.
